title: Sparse head over the M80 concept dictionary and the decisive I5 measurement

dictionary._note: Cell carried from M80 under N80.2: the only admissible cells were m=8192 at k=32 and k=16, and k=32 has the smaller probe deficit (0.51 points) while still beating its random-dictionary null by 3.77 points. The dictionary seed is the run seed, so the three seeds vary the learned basis and not only the head.

i5_eight._note: Drawn once by numpy default_rng(8101).choice(128, 8, replace=False), sorted, and frozen here so the draw cannot be repeated until it flatters a result. The heads are retrained on these 8 classes; the dictionary is NOT refit, so the basis stays the registered 128-class M80 basis.

sparse_linear._note: L1 is applied as a proximal soft-threshold, not as a loss term; see N81.4. Both axes are swept because the explanation-length budget is the quantity under test, so the (I5, citations) trade must be measured rather than assumed at one operating point.

explanations._note: budget is the M79 deployment constraint: an explanation citing more than 10 atoms per decision fails the deployment context even where the gate passes.

i5._note: Explanations are standardised on the probe-training rows only before the logistic probe; see N81.3.

gate.rule: R4 conjunction: I5-8 and I5-128 are both required and neither may be reported alone.
gate._comparability_note: H81 claims an atom head is more simulable than a dense head OF COMPARABLE ACCURACY, so an atom arm more than this many balanced-accuracy points below the best dense control cannot carry the verdict. See N81.7. The degeneracy floor requires an arm to emit at least this fraction of the label space; see N81.8. Both conditions were added after the first run, in which a decision list with 15.74% accuracy emitting 36 of 128 classes carried the I5-128 pass. Because the tolerance was chosen with the data in view, the verdict is recomputed across the sensitivity points above and only a conclusion stable across all of them may be claimed.

i5_eight._note: The original v12 rule, retained unchanged. v12 reference points on 8-way CIFAR-10: GEODE 17.737, RBF 22.772, kNN 25.246, chance 12.500. These are reference points, never bars: every control is re-measured on v13.

i5_128.rule: strictly above the re-measured kNN control on the identical protocol, by more than the spread across seeds 11/23/37

gate._note: Amendment R5: every comparative operand carries a null sharing its structure, budget and split. The shuffled-explanation null must collapse toward chance or the I5 number is uninterpretable.

threading._note: Single-threaded torch is mandatory for gated evidence: at 8 threads the dictionary fit was measured non-reproducible (hash 0e3d8824e18860c4 vs 1b849eff3813577c at one thread).
